items.source: Returns whether the current scroll position is the initial one.
items.translation: 返回当前滚动位置是否为初始位置。

items.source: An initial OffsetScrollPosition does not point to a specific element and is different to a position {ScrollPosition.offset(long).
items.translation: 初始的 OffsetScrollPosition 并不指向特定元素，且与位置 {ScrollPosition.offset(long)} 不同。

items.source: An initial position does not define an offset and will raise an error.
items.translation: initial 位置未定义偏移量，将引发错误。
